scope: Two new matched low-pressure controls, avoiding the recorded simulated glass-burst threshold. Original seven results and expectations remain unchanged.

01-sealed-magnesium.lab.question: Does the sealed thermal refusal preserve Mg and retained nitrogen/oxygen below the mechanical burst threshold?
01-sealed-magnesium.lab.expectation: Mg identity and owned gases remain through ignition and observation; phase changes are allowed. Require typed boundary mismatch, sealed boundary, positive pressure, no thermal equilibrium and no exhaust.

02-sealed-carbon.lab.question: Does the sealed thermal refusal preserve carbon and retained gases below the mechanical burst threshold?
02-sealed-carbon.lab.expectation: Carbon and owned nitrogen/oxygen remain; require typed boundary mismatch, sealed boundary, positive pressure, no thermal equilibrium and no exhaust. The limewater query does not establish closed combustion.
